facts.fact: Adwave ads start at $30 a day, funded from a prepaid wallet with no contract.
facts.quote: Ads start at $30 a day from a prepaid wallet, with no contract.

facts.fact: Connecting Claude to Adwave is free, according to Adwave.
facts.quote: Connecting Claude to Adwave is free.

facts.fact: Adwave says its campaigns run only in the US and Canada.
facts.quote: campaigns run in the US and Canada only.

facts.fact: Anthropic's custom connector guide says Claude's Free plan allows one custom connector.
Anthropic's custom connector guide says on Pro and Max plans users add the custom connector from their own account.
facts.quote: **Pro and Max:** add it from your own account.

facts.fact: Anthropic's custom connector guide says on Team and Enterprise plans an Owner adds the connector for the organization and then each member connects.
facts.quote: an Owner adds it for the organization, then each member connects.

facts.fact: Anthropic wrote in February 2026 that a conversation with Claude is not a good place for advertising, so Claude has no ad slot to buy.
facts.quote: a conversation with Claude isn’t a good place for advertising

facts.fact: The Adwave server URL for connecting to Claude is https://waverunner.adwave.com/api/mcp.
Adwave says the next morning after a campaign runs, the user is charged for what ran, never more than the amount set aside for that day.
facts.quote: The next morning you’re charged for what ran, never more than the amount set aside.

facts.fact: Adwave says a daily budget repeats until the user pauses or ends the campaign.
facts.quote: A daily budget repeats until you pause or end the campaign.

facts.fact: Adwave says new ad campaigns usually start within a few hours after they are sent to each channel for review.
facts.quote: They usually start within a few hours.

facts.fact: Adwave says removing the Claude connector does not stop running ads; campaigns keep running until paused.
facts.quote: removing the connector doesn’t stop your ads.

facts.fact: Adwave says TikTok is opt-in early access and Pinterest is coming soon.
facts.quote: TikTok is opt-in early access. Pinterest is coming soon.

facts.fact: Adwave says it does not do organic social posting, email newsletters or SEO.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t do organic social posting, email newsletters or SEO.

facts.fact: Adwave says it does not guarantee sales or a return on spend, and its forecasts are estimates.
facts.quote: Adwave doesn’t guarantee sales or a return on spend.

facts.fact: Anthropic documents that tools marked destructive always prompt the user in Claude, and Adwave marks every tool that spends as destructive.
facts.quote: Every tool that spends is marked destructive

facts.fact: The page was last updated on November 3, 2026.
